ttfChecks.label: Open contours
ttfChecks.detail: Every required-character contour closes explicitly (an explicit "Z"/closepath command) or implicitly (its final point returns to its starting point).

ttfChecks.label: Self-intersections
ttfChecks.detail: Strict transversal-crossing test (deduplicated, 16-segments-per-curve flattened outline, 69 required characters) found no self- or cross-contour crossings.

evidence.method: FONT-CERT-002: strict proper/transversal crossing test only (no collinear-touching special case -- see glyphOutline.mjs's segmentsIntersect() doc comment for why), run on a deduplicated flattened polygon. Validated against synthetic known-good/known-bad fixtures (tools/test-font-cert-002-outline-detector-fixtures.mjs) and empirically against this candidate: an earlier, unaudited version of this detector reported thousands of false-positive crossings per glyph from curve-tessellation noise.

ttfChecks.label: Zero-length or duplicate outline segments
ttfChecks.detail: 68 of 69 character(s) contain 1631 raw zero-length draw command(s) total (a command whose endpoint exactly duplicates the current pen position -- draws nothing, harmless no-op, but real source-file redundancy), 0 duplicate outline segments. Not production-blocking: these commands have no visual or geometric effect. Per-character counts: "A" (zero-length:39, duplicate:0), "B" (zero-length:35, duplicate:0), "C" (zero-length:20, duplicate:0), "D" (zero-length:28, duplicate:0), "E" (zero-length:28, duplicate:0), "F" (zero-length:38, duplicate:0), "G" (zero-length:29, duplicate:0), "H" (zero-length:49, duplicate:0), +60 more.

evidence.method: FONT-CERT-002: zero-length counted on the raw (unflattened) command stream only -- a command whose target is within 0.05% of the em square of the current pen position. Duplicate-segment counted on the deduplicated flattened polygon. Neither is measured against the flattened/tessellated polygon directly, which previously produced counts inflated by 10-100x from curve-tessellation sampling artifacts.

ttfChecks.label: Coordinates outside valid TrueType ranges
ttfChecks.detail: All required-character outline coordinates fall within the signed 16-bit range (-32768 to 32767).

ttfChecks.label: Inconsistent or suspicious advance widths / side bearings
ttfChecks.detail: Advance widths for required characters cluster reasonably around the median (1309 units).

claudeDesignFeedback: Increase differentiation between "O" and "0" -- their rhinestone stone layouts at SS16 are nearly identical (chamfer distance 0.0665, below the 0.09 similarity threshold; stone counts 53 vs 41). Recommend a clearer distinguishing stroke.

Increase differentiation between "S" and "5" -- their rhinestone stone layouts at SS16 are nearly identical (chamfer distance 0.0731, below the 0.09 similarity threshold; stone counts 45 vs 39). Recommend a clearer distinguishing stroke.

Increase differentiation between "6" and "9" -- their rhinestone stone layouts at SS16 are nearly identical (chamfer distance 0.0853, below the 0.09 similarity threshold; stone counts 45 vs 41). Recommend a clearer distinguishing stroke.
Review stroke weight consistency for: "f" -- their filled-area/bounding-box ratio deviates notably from the a-z median (0.331), suggesting uneven visual weight across the lowercase set.

Confirm this is intentional: "f" (973u below baseline), "z" (895u below baseline) extend below the baseline like a conventional descender (g/j/p/q/y), which is not unusual for a cursive/script style but is worth a deliberate design confirmation rather than an accident of tracing.
